hook_text: Put your ear on your desk and tap the other end. Why is it louder through the wood than through the air?
clip_script: Hum and touch your throat. Buzz! Twang a ruler on the desk. Blurry and noisy! Sprinkle rice on a drum and tap. The rice dances! Every sound is a vibration. Now the vibration travels: through the air like ripples on a pond, all the way to your ear. Put your ear on the desk and tap the far end. Louder through wood! Talk through a string telephone. It works through string and plastic! But in space? Silence. No air, no sound.
visual_style: Whiteboard drum with rings spreading out like ripples on a pond, then the same rings travelling through water, a metal pipe, a wooden desk and a string telephone.
mood: Curious and hands-on, like a science magic show.
pacing: Feel a vibration, see a vibration, then follow sound through five different materials.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and build a string telephone with two yoghurt cups.
